// REQ: LANG-2601 LANG-2602 LANG-2603 LANG-2604
(* Pump control *)
PROGRAM Main
VAR
    start : BOOL := FALSE;
    level : REAL := 0.0;
    timer : TON;
    name : STRING := 'pump''s';
END_VAR
timer(IN := start, PT := T#5S);
IF level > 80.5 AND NOT timer.Q THEN
    start := TRUE;
ELSIF level < 10 THEN
    start := FALSE;
END_IF;
END_PROGRAM
